page.layout: One title page: the printed lines centred from top to bottom. Below "Respondebunt," two columns of names, left then right, each with its own "Ad diem Jan." heading. Below them the place and date, centred. Handwriting at top right is left out.

l.i: In gemino Congressu, pro Examine Theologico

page.notes: Top right: handwritten "18. 9." in ink, not printed, left out. The lines "De", "Ad quam," and "Præside" are in script type. "In gemino Congressu, pro Examine Theologico consequendo," is in italic. The place and date are printed with spacing ("M DC LXXIII"); written here without spaces as the Roman numeral rule requires. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
